correctness.rationale: Write X=uv^T, v^Tu=0, modulo q-1 rescalings. Stratify nonzero u by J²u nonzero, Ju nonzero but J²u zero, and Ju zero; each gives respectively 3,2,1 independent linear covector constraints. Subtract the zero covector in the zero-moment fiber to derive A,B,E. Rank([J,X])<2 iff u belongs to ker J or v to ker J^T; their intersection is governed by the pairing ker J^T x ker J of rank c=2b-d (singleton Jordan blocks), yielding Z and U by projective line counting, with V as the remainder. On span(u,Ju), C has matrix [[-t,-s],[0,t]], and C²=-sX at t=0: this forces every stated odd/even characteristic Jordan type. Independently enumerated actual matrix products, all moments and ranks for six small nilpotent partitions and fields, not as a substitute for proof. All nonnegative multiplicities and full partition of rank-one square-zero X follow.
